applyTo: "**/*.pdf"

# Style Guide for PDF documents

## Tooling

You are not allowed to create PDF documents through any other means but the
approved document creation pipeline that renders PDF from markdown.

This document simply serves as the reference for applying the approved corporate
style guides to the document creation pipeline.

The style guide is non-negotiable and no output document can be released or
published without adhering to this style guide.

## Language, Spelling and Grammar

All published documents shall follow British English for spelling and British
Grammar for punctuation.

## Font Family

Gêr uses the Google Inter Font Family. It is free to use under the SIL Open Font
License Version 1.1. Inter is a variable font family that has been designed for
computer screens. It features a tall x-height to aid in readability of
mixed-case and lower-case text.

## Font Mappings

- Level 1 Heading `#`: Inter Bold 13 pt
- Level 2 Heading `##`: Inter SemiBold 12 pt
- Level 3 Heading `###`: Inter Medium 12 pt
- Body: Inter ExtraLight 11 pt
- Highlight: Inter Medium 11 pt

## Additional Style Guidelines

- Level 1 Heading `#`: Outline Numbered, Border 0.5 pt width, 2 pt from bottom,
  Paragraph Spacing 24 pt before 18 pt after
- Level 2 Heading `##`: Outline Numbered, Paragraph Spacing 18 pt before, 12 pt
  after
- Level 3 Heading `###`: Outline Numbered, Paragraph Spacing 12 pt before 6 pt
  after
- Body: Block justified, Paragraph Spacing 6 pt before 6 pt after, 1.5x line
  spacing

## Rendering of lists

- bullet points and ordered lists shall be rendered as ordered lists in the
  following format (a), (b), (c), etc

## Document Guidelines 

- Header - None
- Footer - Document Title, Document Version, Page x of y, Font Inter Extra Light
  10 pt, Border above text, Text and Border light gray
- Table of Contents mandatory for all documents
- Graphics - all imported graphics should be in .svg or .png format
- Cover Page should have the Gêr Logo (3x3 cm), the Document Title (Inter Bold
  28 pt), Version Control and Author information (Inter Extra Light 11pt). The
  Cover Page should appear vertically centered.
- Background: White
- Text Color: Black and shades of grey
- Border Color: No borders
